folder_layout: raw/<CLASS_NAME>/*.jpg  (one folder per class, mirroring FabricCategory)

collection_guidance.per_class_target: Legacy 17-folder layout is not a release taxonomy. Use release_targets.json: provisional 300 train + 150 validation + 200 independent target-domain test design groups per supported coherent class; expand via learning curves, not image counts.
collection_guidance.capture: Include existing worn dresses and camera/gallery inputs, plus flat/draped cloth. Vary lighting, device, distance, angles, folds and clutter. Source/design/session groups must not cross splits.
collection_guidance.sources: market photography days (Makola, Kantamanto, Kejetia), weaver cooperatives (Bonwire kente, Tamale fugu), user-contributed photos with consent
collection_guidance.avoid: screens, prints of photos, watermarked stock, near-duplicate burst frames
collection_guidance.honesty: Do not infer fibre or authenticity from appearance. Resolve WAX/ANKARA aliases and overlapping families before training; KENTE_PRINT/GONJA unsupported until provenanced examples exist. Independent evaluation, not sample count, determines readiness.

_note: "classes" is the legacy 17-class collection and ingest list and is still read by ingest, scrape and train_finetune.py. The release taxonomy is in the release_* keys below. Training code must read release_visual_families before any training run.
